# BrainBandwidth | AI Cognitive Load Planner
> Cognitive Load-Aware Task & Energy Management System built by Zoth Studio Team (nullai.tech).

## Overview
BrainBandwidth is a full-stack, AI-powered task management and energy scheduling application. It computes real-time mental bandwidth scores (1-10 scale) for tasks based on focus requirement, duration, task category, and circadian fatigue factors.

## Core Concepts & Rules
1. **Brain Bandwidth Score (1-10 Scale)**:
   - 1-3: Low effort, shallow work, administrative routine.
   - 4-6: Moderate effort, group syncs, structured learning.
   - 7-10: High focus, complex code refactoring, system architecture, deep work.
2. **Task Categories**:
   - Deep Work
   - Shallow Work
   - Meetings
   - Learning
   - Personal
   - Admin
3. **Thresholds & Burnout Prevention**:
   - Daily limit target: 10 BW peak. Over 10 BW triggers real-time overload alerts and schedule rebalancing suggestions.

## Key Technical Specifications
- **Frontend**: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Motion (Framer Motion), Lucide Icons, Recharts.
- **Backend Proxy**: Node.js Express server with SQLite local rate limiting & Google Gemini API proxy (`gemini-3-flash-preview`).
- **Offline Resilience**: Built-in heuristic parsing and analytical fallback algorithms when API keys are absent or rate-limited.
- **Accessibility**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant keyboard navigation, ARIA live regions, skip-to-content links.

## Main API Endpoints
- `POST /api/ai/parse-voice`: Parses natural language transcripts into structured JSON tasks with title, category, duration, recurrence, and estimated bandwidth score.
- `POST /api/ai/insights`: Generates a concise daily cognitive briefing given a list of scheduled tasks.
- `POST /api/ai/optimize`: Generates 3 actionable schedule optimization recommendations to prevent burnout.
